text: Please accept this letter as my request to add a new item of business to the July 4th Scarborough Community Council requesting staff to extend the existing sidewalk on the east side of Toyota Place from the Corporate Drive and Toyota Place intersection to the driveway of Toyota Place.

Scarborough Community Council: 1. Requested staff to extend the existing sidewalk on the east side of Toyota Place from the Corporate Drive and Toyota Place intersection to the driveway of Toyota Place.
